generations.name: First generation (I20)
generations.notes: Launch. xDrive50 and M60: 111.5 kWh gross / 105.2 kWh usable, about 195-200 kW DC. xDrive40: 76.6 kWh gross / 71 kWh usable, 150 kW DC (Canada from MY2023, US MY2024-2025 per the ratings). Two packs, so two powertrains in this generation. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_iX

generations.name: 2026 update (LCI)
generations.notes: LCI with new packs: xDrive45 about 100 kWh gross / 94.8 kWh usable, 175 kW DC; xDrive60 and M70 about 113 kWh gross / 109.1 kWh usable, 195 kW DC. New names (xDrive45, xDrive60, M70) in both regulators from MY2026. Confidence: medium-high (Wikipedia mixes gross/net for the LCI) (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_iX
